capabilities: scroll the viewport one line up or down with Ctrl+Up/Down
keep the cursor position while scrolling
reassign the scroll commands to custom hotkeys via a setting
expose scroll line up/down as command palette commands
extras: The built-in Ctrl+Up/Down binding can be disabled in settings in favor of custom hotkeys; the two commands remain available in the command palette either way.
problem: Obsidian lacks the code-editor behavior where Ctrl+Up/Down scroll the view by one line while the cursor stays put.
summary: Keyboard shortcut plugin that scrolls the editor viewport one line at a time with Ctrl+Up/Down without moving the cursor.
